notes.zh: Aimloom 改用 Rust 写的引擎读写游戏文件，不再需要 PowerShell 7，安装程序只有约 3 MB。左侧导航改成两页：「探索」（快速导入、备份与恢复、官网探索页）和「更改配置」（Profile、背景、音效、准星、敌人）。快速导入（原「一键拖入」）改成「拖入、看一眼、加进游戏」：一次可以拖入或选择多个配置包、文件夹和文件，按文件格式识别背景、音效和准星；已经在游戏里的不会被覆盖，跳过的每个文件都写明原因；个人设置（灵敏度、DPI、FOV 等）放在默认收起的「高级」里，勾选才导入。Profile 改成完整快照：记录背景和全部 6 个音效事件，新建时默认就是游戏当前的设置。背景和音效可以收藏，收藏的排在最前。相比测试版的修复：快速导入或恢复之后，各页的列表会重新读取；写入进行中关闭窗口，每个页面都会给出提示；Profile 页会说明旧版本保存的 Profile 读不了，并可以直接删除。
notes.en: Aimloom now reads and writes the game's files with an engine written in Rust, so PowerShell 7 is no longer needed and the installer is about 3 MB. The sidebar becomes two pages: Explore (Quick import, Backup and restore, and the website's explorer) and Customize (Profile, Theme, Sounds, Crosshair, Enemy). Quick import becomes drop, look, add: drop or choose several packs, folders and files at once; themes, sounds and crosshairs are recognised by their file format. Nothing already in the game is overwritten, and each skipped file says why. Personal settings (sensitivity, DPI, FOV and more) sit under a collapsed Advanced and are imported only when ticked. A Profile is now a complete snapshot of the theme and all six sound events, and a new one starts as the game is. Themes and sounds can be starred; favourites are listed first. Fixed since the betas: lists are read again after Quick import or a restore; closing the window during a write shows a notice on every page; the Profile page says that a Profile saved by an older version cannot be read and lets you delete it.

zh: 从 0.1.5 或更早版本升级：请先在 Windows 设置里卸载旧版本的 Aimloom，再安装这个版本。卸载不会删除你的备份。已经装了 0.1.6 测试版的，直接运行这个安装程序即可。
0.1.5 及更早版本存的 Profile 这个版本读不出来，需要在 Profile 页删除后重新创建；在 0.1.6 里新建的 Profile，装回 0.1.5 后也打不开。
同一次导入里如果有同名的音效（比如同时有 .wav 和 .ogg）或内部名称相同的主题，只加入第一个：游戏按名字识别它们，两个都放进去哪个都用不了。
如果你的桌面或下载文件夹由 OneDrive 同步，从那里拖入或添加的文件会被拒绝（提示不允许链接）：先把文件复制到不在 OneDrive 里的文件夹再导入。
没有代码签名证书：运行安装程序（或便携版的 Aimloom.exe）时 Windows 会提示「已保护你的电脑」，点「更多信息」→「仍要运行」。
用哪个准星要在游戏设置里选，Aimloom 读不到也改不了这个选择。
en: Coming from 0.1.5 or earlier: uninstall the older Aimloom in Windows Settings first, then install this version. Uninstalling keeps your backups. If you have a 0.1.6 beta installed, just run this installer.
Profiles saved by 0.1.5 or earlier cannot be read by this version: delete them on the Profile page and create them again. Profiles made in 0.1.6 cannot be opened after going back to 0.1.5.

If one import holds two sounds with the same name (a .wav and an .ogg, say) or two themes with the same internal name, only the first is added: the game tells them apart by name, so with both neither would work.
If OneDrive syncs your Desktop or Downloads folder, files dropped or added from there are refused ("Links and junctions are not allowed"): copy them to a folder outside OneDrive first.
No code-signing certificate: running the installer (or the portable Aimloom.exe) shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway.
The crosshair in use is chosen in the game's settings; Aimloom can neither read nor change that choice.

notes.zh: 快速导入（原「一键拖入」）改成「拖入、看一眼、加进游戏」：在「探索」页一次可以拖入或选择多个配置包、文件夹和文件，按文件格式识别背景、音效和准星；已经在游戏里的不会被覆盖，跳过的每个文件都写明原因；个人设置（灵敏度、DPI、FOV 等）放在默认收起的「高级」里，勾选才导入。「备份与恢复」成为探索页的第三张卡。背景和音效可以收藏，收藏的排在最前，在 Profile 里选择时也一样。修复：导入中途被打断后，恢复会清掉留下的临时文件。
notes.en: Quick import becomes drop, look, add: on Explore, drop or choose several packs, folders and files at once; themes, sounds and crosshairs are recognised by their file format. Nothing already in the game is overwritten, and each skipped file says why. Personal settings (sensitivity, DPI, FOV and more) sit under a collapsed Advanced and are imported only when ticked. Backup and restore is Explore's third card. Themes and sounds can be starred; favourites are listed first, also when choosing in a Profile. Fixed: restoring an import that was interrupted now removes the temporary copy it left.

notes.en: Aimloom now comes with PowerShell 7, so nothing else needs installing; the installer is about 81 MB and the portable ZIP about 114 MB as a result. Theme, Sounds and Crosshair can open the explorer on aimloom.dev to download backgrounds, sounds and crosshairs their authors allow to share. After you link a Steam account, its name starts as your Steam name and can be changed; a saved account can be renamed. The code inside was also reorganized, with no change to what you see or do.

The enemy skin list is built in for the current game version; skins the game adds later can be chosen once Aimloom is updated.

notes.zh: 准星页可以微调：粘贴 CS2 或 VALORANT 的准星代码后，用滑块调长度、粗细、间隙、描边、颜色、中心点和透明度，在深色和浅色背景上实时预览，再作为新准星加进游戏。Profile 的应用对话框多了「应用并启动游戏」：应用后通过 Steam 直接打开 KovaaK。Profile 卡片改成新样式；在 Profile 里换背景和音效时可以搜索，也可以直接从电脑添加文件。背景页加了搜索。背景、音效、敌人页上放弃未应用选择的按钮改叫「退出」。「设置」里可以打开「参与 Beta 测试」，以后会提示测试版更新。
notes.en: The Crosshair page can fine-tune a pasted CS2 or VALORANT code: sliders for length, thickness, gap, outline, colour, centre dot and alpha, a live preview on a dark and a light background, then add it to the game as a new crosshair. The Profile apply dialog adds "Apply and start the game", which opens KovaaK through Steam after applying. Profile cards have a new layout; choosing a background or sounds inside a Profile has a search box and can add a file from your computer. The Theme page has a search box. On Theme, Sounds and Enemy look, the button that drops an unapplied choice now reads "Cancel". Settings has a "Join the beta" switch that offers beta updates.

Needs PowerShell 7; the PowerShell 5.1 built into Windows is not enough. The installer can install it with winget, but that step has not been verified on a clean PC yet.

notes.zh: Profile 可以「应用」了：一次把保存的背景和音效写入游戏；Profile 只存背景和音效，列表里直接显示「保持当前」保持的是哪一个。Enemy 页改成游戏自带「皮肤浏览器」的皮肤：人形、方块、球各选一个。改设置（背景、音效、皮肤、Profile）前必须退出游戏，游戏开着时会拒绝写入，因为游戏退出时会覆盖掉改动；应用也快了很多。可以在「设置」里发送问题报告、添加 Steam 账户（可选），启动时会检查有没有新版本（可关闭）。更多老格式主题可以用作背景。能从 Steam 的游戏库里找到游戏。「安装与恢复」改名为「一键拖入」。
notes.en: Profiles can now be applied: "Apply" writes the saved background and sounds to the game at once; a Profile holds the background and sounds, and the list names what "Keep current" keeps. The Enemy look page now sets the game's own Skin Browser skins: one each for humanoid, cube and sphere. Changing settings (background, sounds, skin, Profile) needs the game closed: while it runs, Aimloom refuses to write, because the game overwrites the change when it exits. Applying is much faster. Settings can send a problem report and add an optional Steam account, and the App checks for a new version at launch (you can turn this off). More older themes can be used as a background. The game is found through Steam's library list. "Install & restore" is now "Quick import".

notes.zh: 新增安装程序：运行后从开始菜单打开 Aimloom；没有 PowerShell 7 时，它会问你要不要用 winget 装上。App 新增英文界面：第一次打开跟随 Windows 显示语言，可以在左下角的「设置」里切换。两个栏目改用 KovaaK 自己的叫法：Theme 和 Sounds。「安装与恢复」页换成了和其他页面同一套浅色。便携版 ZIP 照常提供，两种方式共用同一份备份和 Profile。
notes.en: New: an installer. Run it, then open Aimloom from the Start menu; if PowerShell 7 is missing, it offers to install it with winget. The app now has an English interface: the first launch follows the Windows display language, and Settings at the bottom left switches it. Two sections are named after KovaaK's own words: Theme and Sounds. Install & restore now uses the same light colours as the other pages. The portable ZIP is still offered; both share the same backups and Profiles.

大约五分之一的主题缺少天花板或斜坡的设置，暂时不能用作背景：应用时会被拒绝，不会写入任何文件。
用哪个准星要在游戏设置里选，Aimloom 读不到也改不了这个选择。
游戏运行时应用的改动是否立即生效、退出游戏后是否保留，还没有验证；建议关闭游戏后再应用。

Needs PowerShell 7; the PowerShell 5.1 built into Windows is not enough. The installer can install it with winget, but that step has not been verified on a clean PC yet.
About one theme in five lacks the ceiling or ramp settings and cannot be used as a background yet: applying it is refused and nothing is written.
The crosshair in use is chosen in the game's settings; Aimloom can neither read nor change that choice.
Whether a change applied while the game runs takes effect at once, or survives quitting the game, is not verified yet; apply with the game closed.

notes.zh: 第一个公开的测试版。背景、音效、准星、敌人外观四个配置页：先预览，再应用，写入前自动备份，可撤销。可以从外部添加主题、音效和准星（选择文件或拖进窗口），把 CS2 / VALORANT 准星代码转成 PNG 直接加进游戏，并把常用组合存成训练 Profile。
notes.en: The first public beta. Four pages — background, sounds, crosshair and enemy look — where you preview first and then apply, with a backup before every write and undo at any time. Add themes, sounds and crosshairs from outside (pick a file or drag it in), turn CS2 / VALORANT crosshair codes into PNGs added straight to the game, and save the combinations you use as training Profiles.
